inspiration: Sky from lookup bands, not a painted gradient: each zone points at a parameter set with top, middle and horizon colours and fog, indexed by time of day. Our version could use our own band table per biome with a day-night curve, and set fog equal to the horizon colour so there is no seam.

Ground from four layers and paint masks: each terrain chunk blends four texture layers with alpha maps, at five level-of-detail steps. Recreate with our own biome materials and hand-painted masks, with noise breakup on the blend edges.
Water as a translucent pass: flat alpha-blended planes are drawn after opaque geometry, so the sort order does the work. Our water could use its own tint and wave normals on the same pass order.
Trails for motion: billboarded, additive particles plus ribbons (trails) show swings and spells at a glance. Our version could use original trail shapes and colour ramps per element.
Text and UI share one small shader pair: a glyph atlas drawn by a dedicated text shader, and textured quads for panels. The idea is cheap, legible UI.

Addon-like UI: the UI loads addon files from a table of contents and runs their scripts in a Lua VM, with system addons placed in a protected group. Our HUD could work the same way, with a protected core set of panels.

briefs.label: Dusk sky dome
briefs.why: One gradient sets the mood of a whole zone; a horizon-matched fog hides where the sky meets the ground.
briefs.keep: A colour band per time of day; the horizon colour drives the fog; a sun disc placed from the clock.
briefs.change: Our own palette per biome; a moon in a different place; painted clouds in place of flat bands.

briefs.label: Layered painted ground
briefs.why: Four texture layers blended with paint masks read as real ground, not repeated tiles.
briefs.keep: A mask per chunk; four layers; level-of-detail steps with distance.
briefs.change: Our own biome materials; masks painted by hand; noise breakup on the blend edges.

briefs.label: Ribbon trail effect
briefs.why: A trail shows the motion of a swing or spell at a glance.
briefs.keep: Additive trail; billboarded to the camera; a fading tail.
briefs.change: Our own colour ramp per element; a jagged or flame edge; tail length tuned per ability.
